prompts.props:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready transparent sprite atlas for a miniature tactical browser game
Primary request: An original 2D raster sprite sheet inspired by PUBG PC vehicles and loot; do not reproduce official art.
Canvas and grid: precisely 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 equal square cells, landscape 2:1 ratio, preferably 1536x768. Transparent alpha background throughout. No drawn grid lines.
Exact cell order reading left to right: row 1: a redzone falling missile, olive green UAZ military jeep, blue angular 1970s Pony Coupe, yellow low sporty Coupe RB. Row 2: red Mirado classic long American muscle coupe, tan rugged pickup truck, olive fragmentation grenade, wooden death loot crate.
Composition: Each single object centered inside its own cell, generous empty transparent margin at least 15%, all object edges entirely within cell. All five vehicles in strict flat side view facing RIGHT, wheels aligned, no three-quarter view. Missile vertical with pointed nose down and fins up, no fire. Grenade and crate clear game icons.
Style/medium: crisp hand-painted 2D game sprites, warm muted colors, simple robust shapes, clean dark brown outlines, soft subtle material shading, little highlights, readable small scale, cohesive cute miniature tactical aesthetic. Vehicles recognizable silhouettes with two visible black wheels. Not photorealistic.
Constraints: exactly eight sprites, isolated separate objects, no scenery, no shadows extending outside objects, no UI, no text, no numerals, no logos, no labels, no frames, no watermark. True transparency, no white rectangle, no checkerboard baked into image.
prompts.gear:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: layered character and equipment transparent sprite atlas for a miniature tactical browser game
Primary request: original painted 2D game sprites inspired by PUBG PC, consistent warm muted colors and crisp dark outlines, simplified detailed miniatures.
Canvas: portrait 2:3 ratio, exactly 4 columns x 6 rows of equal square cells (24 cells), preferably 1024x1536. True transparent alpha background. Each object fully inside its own cell, centered with at least 15% padding, no grid lines.
EXACT ROW/CELL CONTENTS left to right:
Row 1: Four successive full body frames of the SAME male soldier running toward RIGHT, strict flat side camera. Young adult short dark hair bare head, light beige short sleeve shirt, brown combat pants, boots. NO weapon, NO vest, NO helmet, no backpack. Four clearly different running stride poses, identical character scale and head/body placement.
Row 2: isolated side facing right helmets only: level 1 dark biker helmet; level 2 olive military helmet; level 3 heavy black PUBG-style full face armored helmet; fourth cell EMPTY transparent.
Row 3: isolated torso clothing equipment only, flat side view facing right: level 1 simple green kevlar vest; level 2 olive tactical plate vest with pouches; level 3 black heavy armored vest; bushy green ghillie torso garment. NO heads, NO limbs, NO people wearing these.
Row 4: isolated firearms pointing RIGHT horizontal flat side silhouettes: AUG bullpup rifle; M416 black carbine; Beryl wood and black AK style rifle; MP5K short black compact submachine gun.
Row 5: isolated firearms pointing RIGHT: ACE rifle tan and black; K2 black Korean rifle; SCAR tan rifle; UMP black submachine gun.
Row 6: isolated firearms pointing RIGHT: double barrel shotgun wooden stock; M24 olive bolt action rifle with scope; AWM green long sniper rifle with scope; Lynx heavy black anti materiel rifle with scope.
Style: hand-painted warm stylized crisp game art, clean silhouettes with dark brown outlines and subtle brush texture, simplified identifiable equipment shapes, readable at small size. Equipment intended to be drawn as independent overlays. All guns stock at left muzzle at right.
Constraints: only the exact sprites, no extra weapons or people, no faces inside helmets, no text or logos or watermarks or labels or UI. Every cell isolated and separated. True alpha transparency, no baked checkerboard, no scenery.
prompts.maps:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: six-panel environment backdrop atlas for a miniature tactical browser game
Primary request: Original painted landscape interpretations inspired by six PUBG PC maps, same warm crisp miniature 2D hand-painted aesthetic, subtle paperlike brush texture, softly outlined foliage and architecture.
Canvas/grid: Exactly 3 columns x 2 rows, six equal portrait panels each aspect ratio 2:3, overall square 1536x1536 canvas. Seamlessly abutting panels with no borders or gaps. Each panel is a separate landscape; do not merge horizons across panels. No text anywhere.
Exact reading order:
Top left Erangel: pastoral rolling green farmland and gold wheat, slender Eastern European church steeple and old Soviet village houses with orange tile roofs, blue wooded hills.
Top middle Miramar: warm ochre desert with layered mesas and sandstone rocks, Mexican hacienda with terracotta roofs, scattered cacti.
Top right Taego: Korean countryside with golden crop fields, Korean hanok houses and charcoal tiled roofs, green low forest mountains.
Bottom left Sanhok: lush humid tropical jungle, palms and broad leaves, weathered mossy stone temple ruins and distant misty hills.
Bottom middle Vikendi: snowy ground, dark evergreen pine woods, alpine chalet, ice-blue snowy mountains.
Bottom right Rondo: bamboo groves, steep hazy karst hills, distant modern Asian city skyline with restrained contemporary buildings and traditional tiled-roof structure.
Composition in EVERY panel: Far scenery, trees, distinctive buildings, and horizon confined to upper HALF of the panel. LOWER HALF is an uncluttered broad expanse of softly textured walkable terrain appropriate to that biome, seen slightly from above, suitable for overlaying sprites and interface. Lower half grass for Erangel/Taego/Rondo, sand for Miramar, forest earth for Sanhok, snow for Vikendi. NO roads cluttering the lower half. Enough sky above hills to give airy readable scene. Consistent camera angle and horizon height at 40% of each panel.
Lighting: warm soft daylight with gentle atmospheric depth, snowy panel cool luminous daylight. Calm inviting tactical game world.
Constraints: no people, no animals, no vehicles, no weapons, no UI, no map markers, no lines, no map labels, no logos or watermark. Not screenshots or official assets. Six distinguishable environments with precisely ordered panels. No black gaps.

note: All generated art is original stylized interpretation; official reference raster files were not reused in project. Sprite sheets were mechanically sliced, resized and packed into exact equal cells with ImageMagick, alpha preserved. Soldier bare head/unarmed, guns right pointing. Generated vests are front-facing although requested side-view.
